wars.name: Senussi campaign
wars.outcome: British-Italian victory: the Senussi left Sollum, Sidi Barrani and the oases of the Western Desert in 1916 and 1917; the modus vivendi of 12 April 1917 recognised Idris as emir of Cyrenaica and left Jaghbub under Egyptian sovereignty.

certainty.note: The Egyptian frontiers as the kingdom's shape has them; no page opened describes a survey.
The Western Desert oases and the coast west of Sidi Barrani were held and lost by the Senussi in 1915-1917.
